name: Stone tablet with Rune
description: A sturdy stone table with a glowing rune carved into its surface. It radiates a pleasant warmth, making the outhouse comfortable despite the cold outside.

params.fail_message: Looks like a expensive magical item of some sort, its hot when it glows though.
params.success_message: It is a stone plate carved with a Rune of heating, it will activate when placed on a wall in a room and start to heat it up to a comfortable temperature.
The rune stops glowing when you take it.
